issues.ORIGIN_REQUIRED: Choose an origin to plan the outbound and return journeys.
issues.DATE_INVALID: Departure or return date is invalid.
issues.DATE_ORDER: The return date must be after departure.
issues.END_DATE_REQUIRED: Choose an end date or use number of days.
issues.TRIP_LENGTH: The trip must be between 1 and 30 days.
issues.TRAVELERS_INVALID: At least one adult and at most 20 travelers; children's ages must be 0–17.
issues.TRAVEL_TIME_ORDER: Return departure must be after arrival at the destination.
issues.FLIGHT_TIMES_MISSING: Flight times are missing; transport and buffers are estimates.
issues.TICKET_DETAILS_MISSING: Enter the provider and confirmed ticket times.
issues.BOOKED_STAY_REQUIRED: Enter the name of your booked accommodation.
issues.STAY_NOT_SELECTED: Accommodation will be suggested. You can choose and book later.
issues.ALLERGY_CONFIRMATION: Contact the venue directly to confirm allergies; suggestions do not guarantee allergy safety.
issues.STAY_OVER_BUDGET: Accommodation alone exceeds the group budget.
issues.DAY_COUNT_MISMATCH: The result does not cover the requested days; regenerate it.
issues.OUTBOUND_MISSING: The outbound segment needs more information.
issues.RETURN_MISSING: The return segment needs more information.
issues.OVER_BUDGET: Estimated cost exceeds the budget by {amount} {currency}.
issues.TRAVEL_CONFLICT: {activity}: overlaps travel or its time buffer.
issues.COST_MISMATCH: Component costs do not match the total; check before booking.
issues.UNEXPECTED_STAY_COST: An overnight-free trip has accommodation costs.
issues.SOURCE_LOCALE_UNKNOWN: The source language is unknown. Create a new itinerary before regenerating sections.
issues.TRANSLATION_SAME_LANGUAGE: The itinerary already uses this language.
issues.TRANSLATION_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: Translation is unavailable with the current AI provider.
issues.SOURCE_NOT_FOUND: The source is unavailable or you no longer have access.
issues.TOO_MANY_JOBS: Too many requests are pending. Try again later.
issues.TRANSLATION_FAILED: Translation failed. You can try again.
issues.TRANSLATION_LOAD_FAILED: Could not load translations. Reload to try again.
issues.TRANSLATION_INVALID_TEXT: The translation response is invalid. Please try again.
issues.PLANNING_FAILED: The request could not be completed. Try again later.
issues.LOCATION_INPUT_REQUIRED: Enter a location or both coordinates.
issues.STAY_LENGTH_INVALID: Check-out must follow check-in, with at most 365 nights.
issues.BOOKING_DETAILS_REQUIRED: Confirming a booking requires a provider and check-in/out dates.
issues.STAY_VERSION_REQUIRED: An accommodation version is required to update it.
issues.STAY_CONFLICT: The accommodation changed or you cannot edit it.
issues.PLAN_NOT_FOUND: This trip has no itinerary yet.
issues.LEGACY_REGENERATION_REQUIRED: Regenerate the legacy itinerary with structured criteria before editing sections.
issues.ITEM_NOT_MEAL: This item is not a meal or café.
issues.REPLACEMENT_MEAL_MISSING: No suitable replacement venue is available.
issues.STAY_LOCKED: Booked or locked accommodation cannot be automatically replaced.
issues.LOCKED_DAY_MISSING: The previous version is missing a day containing a locked item.
issues.APPLY_HOST_ONLY: Only the host or co-host can apply a revision.
issues.APPLY_PERMISSION_CHANGED: Your permission to apply this revision changed.
issues.REVISION_UNAVAILABLE: This preview was applied or is no longer valid.
issues.REVISION_INVALID: The preview has timing or constraint errors. Regenerate it before applying.
issues.LODGING_OVER_BUDGET: Accommodation alone exceeds the group budget.
